title: Practice 6: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Can you predict the future?
exercises.why: **обладать → обладаешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Lions don't miaow, they roar.
exercises.why: **мяукать → мяукают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It is unconstitutional.
exercises.why: **противоречить → противоречит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Курица ___ (высиживать) яйца, пока не вылупятся цыплята.
exercises.prompt: The hen sits on her eggs until the chicks hatch.
exercises.why: **высиживать → высиживает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The car is turning left.
exercises.why: **поворачивать → поворачивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: A cow goes moo, a cat goes meow.
exercises.why: **мычать → мычит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: В течение зимы птицы ___ (питаться) такими плодами, как шиповник.
exercises.prompt: Through winter, the birds feed on such things as rose hips.
exercises.why: **питаться → питаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Янни ___ (разговаривать) о том, как убрать трещины-бычие глаза на лобовом стекле.
exercises.prompt: Yanni is talking about how to fix bullseyes in windshields.
exercises.why: **разговаривать → разговаривает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Скоростная линия Томей ___ (соединять) Токио с Нагоей.
exercises.prompt: The Tomei Expressway connects Tokyo with Nagoya.
exercises.why: **соединять → соединяет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Love is blinding you.
exercises.why: **ослеплять → ослепляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Are you referring to me?
exercises.why: **обращаться → обращаетесь** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Мне плевать на политику, я ___ (ждать) второго пришествия Исуса Христа.
exercises.prompt: I don't give a damn about the politics, I'm just waiting for the second coming of Jesus Christ.
exercises.why: **ждать → жду** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: I blush when I see you.
exercises.why: **краснеть → краснею** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: The fishing boats leave harbour.
exercises.why: **покидать → покидают** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Those people appreciate clarity.
exercises.why: **ценить → ценят** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Мужчины ___ (строить) дома, женщины создают домашний очаг.
exercises.prompt: Men make houses, women make homes.
exercises.why: **строить → строят** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Несколько садовников ___ (заботиться) об азалиях в парке.
exercises.prompt: Several gardeners look after the azaleas in the park.
exercises.why: **заботиться → заботится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: «___ (обожать) по утрам есть обед», — говорит король Харкиниан.
exercises.prompt: "I love me some dinner in the morning," says King Harkinian.
exercises.why: **обожать → Обожаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: This is how they talk women out of abortions.
exercises.why: **отговаривать → отговаривают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Том ___ (интересоваться) кухней Японии и недавно, помимо прочего, искал рецепт мисо-супа.
exercises.prompt: Tom has an interest in Japanese cuisine, and recently, he has been searching for recipes to make miso soup, among other things.
exercises.why: **интересоваться → интересуется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
